mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.credential_version, COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT r.code, ',') FROM iam_account_role ar JOIN iam_role r ON r.id = ar.role_id AND r.enabled WHERE ar.account_id = a.id), '') AS roles, COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT rg.permission_code, ',') FROM iam_account_role ar JOIN iam_role r ON r.id = ar.role_id AND r.enabled JOIN iam_role_grant rg ON rg.role_id = r.id WHERE ar.account_id = a.id), '') AS permissions FROM iam_session_grant g JOIN iam_account a ON a.id = g.account_id WHERE g.token_digest = #{digest} AND NOT g.revoked AND g.expires_at > clock_timestamp() AND a.enabled AND a.credential_version = g.credential_version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_session_grant (token_digest, account_id, credential_version, expires_at, revoked) VALUES (#{digest}, #{account}, #{version}, #{expires}, false)
